why: Cast Incinerate on Alpine Grizzly. Costs {1}{R} (2 mana), deals 3 damage, kills the 4/2 creature before it can attack next turn. With 3 untapped Mountains, I have plenty of mana. Removing this threat is critical—Alpine Grizzly would deal 4 damage/turn starting turn 7. Better to spend 2 mana killing it now than take 4+ damage. After this, I'll attack for 2 with my creatures.
